notes.title: Adventurer’s Odyssey
notes.content:
Get ready, adventurers! The latest update for Realm Drifter introduces three brand-new maps for you to explore: "Mystery Anethaem," "The Climb," and "Sunken City." But that's not all—existing maps have been enriched with new additions and intricate details, including brand-new Easter eggs waiting to be discovered. Dive back into the world of Realm Drifter and experience your favorite locations in exciting new ways!

Additionally:

- Minor big fixes
